summary: Characterizing noise in superconducting qubits is essential for improving coherence and gate performance. summary: Flux-driven two-fluid simulations in a diverted tokamak exhibit a confinement transition when a critical heating threshold is exceeded, as in experimental observations of the L-H transition. title: Emergence of a Symmetry-Broken Chern Insulator near a Moiré Kondo Breakdown
summary: A new class of topological states emerging near a Kondo breakdown in a moiré Kondo lattice system reveals a connection between the chiral Kondo interaction and the formation of topologically nontrivial states at fractional moiré fillings—an observation that has not been reported in previous heavy-fermion systems.

title: Symbolic Quantum-Trajectory Method for Multichannel Dicke Superradiance
summary: We solve Dicke superradiance with two or more competing collective decay channels of tunable rates using a symbolic quantum-trajectory construction. The method yields closed time-domain populations and observables as finite combinations of exponential terms for arbitrary numbers of emitters and arbi…

title: Evolution of the Superfluid Density in Infinite-Layer Nickelates
summary: An experiment enables the first systematic, absolute superfluid-density measurement across the full superconducting dome of an infinite-layer nickelate.

title: Compressive Splitting in Brittle Solids: The Inverse of Wrinkling in Sheets
summary: Theory and experiments suggest that the mysterious fractures that appear when a brittle material is compressed result from a hidden buildup of internal tension.

title: Anomalous Diffusion and Singular Transport from Hydrodynamic Recoupling
summary: In charge neutral fluids, such as the Dirac fluid in graphene at the Dirac point, charge transport remains diffusive despite the presence of ballistically propagating sound waves: sound waves “hydrodynamically decouple” from the slower charge fluctuations. For quasi-one-dimensional charge neutral fl…

title: Realization of Repulsive Polarons in the Strongly Correlated Regime
summary: A stable repulsive Bose polaron is realized in a two-dimensional quantum gas by encoding impurities and their surrounding quantum medium in different vibrational states, allowing for the investigation of quasiparticle properties in the strongly interacting regime.

title: Temporal Complexity Hierarchies in Solvable Quantum Many-Body Dynamics
summary: Researchers establish a framework based on geometric group theory to classify the temporal computational complexity and quantum memory structures of solvable quantum many-body dynamics.

title: Order by Inertia in Spinning Active Matter: Holey Fluids and Spin-Textured Crystals
summary: Experiments with macroscopic spinning particles that stir the surrounding fluid at high Reynolds numbers reveal that inertia plays an organizing role in active systems, promoting the emergence of collective structured phases.

title: Ionization and Dissociation Energies of Molecular Hydrogen
summary: A fivefold improvement in the accuracy of the ionization and dissociation energies of molecular hydrogen is achieved, establishing stringent benchmarks for two-electron quantum calculations in the context of searches for physics beyond the standard model.

title: Metastable Phase Separation and Information Retrieval in Multicomponent Liquids
summary: A thermodynamic theory shows that multicomponent liquid mixtures can store prescribed compositions as metastable states and retrieve them from partial seeds, realizing associative memory in a demixing liquid.

title: Tripartite Haar Random State Has No Bipartite Entanglement
summary: Researchers demonstrate that bipartite Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen entanglement cannot be distilled from tripartite Haar random states by local operations.

title: Mixed-State Phases from Local Reversibility
summary: Researchers establish a framework using local reversibility to correctly classify phases of matter in open and noisy quantum systems.

title: Enduring Mechanical Memory from the Constitutive Response of Elastically Recoverable Nanostructured Materials
summary: Vertically aligned carbon nanotube foams exhibit return point memory, opening new opportunities for mechanical computing applications.

title: Geometrically Frustrated Quadrupoles on the Pyrochlore Lattice and Generalized Spin Liquids
summary: A semiclassical framework models quantum quadrupoles as biaxial tensors, showing how angular-momentum-dependent geometries dictate generalized nematic phases and quadrupolar spin liquids in frustrated magnets.

title: Emergent Altermagnetism at Surfaces of Antiferromagnets: Full Symmetry Classification and Material Identification
summary: A theoretical surface spin-group framework demonstrates that surface symmetry breaking in conventional antiferromagnets naturally induces two-dimensional altermagnetism across more than 150 candidate materials.

title: Quantum Birthmarks: Ergodicity Breaking Beyond Scarring
summary: Researchers develop a theoretical framework showing that quantum systems permanently retain a memory of their initial state and early dynamics, in defiance of classical expectations.

title: Effective Ionic Valence and Local Magnetic Moment in Kagome Superconductors
summary: Revealing concealed ionic local moments in kagome superconductors reflects strong local correlations.

title: Ultrastrong Unconventional Spin Current via Noncollinear Spin-Orbit Filtering
summary: An asymmetric platinum interface enables noncollinear spin-orbit filtering, breaking bulk symmetry constraints to generate out-of-plane spin currents for field-free magnetization switching.

title: Experimentally Accessible Measurement of Irreversibility in Stochastic Systems by Categorizing Single-Molecule Displacements
summary: A model-free method that infers irreversibility directly from single-molecule position recordings offers a versatile and accessible tool to characterize the nonequilibrium behavior of small, time-dependent, continuous systems.

title: Standard Model of Electromagnetism and Chirality in Crystals
summary: A comprehensive symmetry-based classification identifies 12 fundamentally distinct types of crystal structures across five polar and five chiral categories, providing a complete taxonomy to predict and engineer next-generation multifunctional materials.

title: Coulomb Screening of Superconductivity in Magic-Angle Graphene
summary: Metallic layers placed near magic-angle graphene suppress Coulomb interactions and reveal that its superconductivity is driven by electronic interactions rather than conventional atomic vibrations.

title: Fast Algorithm for 2D Rigidity Percolation
summary: An algorithm for simulating the rigidity percolation transition, based on novel theoretical results, overcomes previous size limitations and enables the highly precise characterization of its universality classes, shedding new light on rigidity transitions in amorphous systems.
